No `total_pages` field was seen anywhere; the response's `info` object exactly matches the declared shape (page, page_size, count, prev, next), all present, both prev and next null. Do not read this run as confirming the multi-page envelope — it confirms only the single-page one. No container-shape mismatch (data is declared and returned as an array, not a map). No unfalsifiable {type:object} contracts encountered — all declared shapes here are concretely typed.
